description: check_revocation at ocsp.rs:158: when issuerNameHash or issuerKeyHash mismatches, returns Err(OcspStatusUnknown). A hash mismatch means the response is for a different cert/issuer, not that the responder returned unknown status. The correct error is OcspSignatureInvalid or a new OcspCertIdMismatch. In hard-fail mode the caller still rejects, but error messages and matching code treating OcspStatusUnknown as 'try another responder' will silently swallow a wrong-responder attack.
title: OCSP CertID hash mismatch returns OcspStatusUnknown (misleading error)
